name: subject_replace
description:
Replace the original person entirely, including face, hair, outfit,
and all accessories.

name: pose_lock
description:
Strictly preserve the original body proportions, body position,
framing, camera perspective, and overall composition from the source
image.
The new person must closely align with the original skeleton, body
gesture, and placement in the frame, while allowing only slight
natural adjustments to the head angle, eye direction, neck,
shoulders, and upper-body orientation so the subject can face the
camera naturally and comfortably.

name: camera_facing
description:
The face must face the camera clearly, with direct or near-direct
eye contact.
The face should be frontal or near-frontal, with both eyes clearly
visible.
Keep the pose natural and relaxed.
Do not generate profile view, strong three-quarter view,
side-looking face angles, looking away, downward gaze, or unnatural
neck twisting.

name: outfit_replace
description:
Wear the outfit from the reference garment image, strictly matching
the color, silhouette, structure, styling, and fabric details.
The clothing should fit naturally on the body, with realistic folds,
correct tension, and believable fabric behavior based on the pose.
Completely remove all original clothing, accessories, jewelry, and
handheld objects.
Do not retain, partially preserve, or blend any original outfit
elements.

name: scene_consistency
description:
Seamlessly integrate the new person into the original scene with
accurate scale, perspective, depth, and spatial consistency.
Lighting must strictly follow the original image, including
direction, intensity, shadow softness, highlight behavior, and color
temperature.
Preserve the realism of the original environment and ensure the
subject is fully consistent with the scene.

name: negative_prompt
description:
low quality, blurry, over-retouched skin, plastic skin, heavy AI
artifacts, ghosting, double face, mismatched face, distorted face,
asymmetrical eyes, broken facial features, side-looking face,
profile face, looking away, downward gaze, unnatural neck twist,
deformed hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, bad anatomy, incorrect
body proportions, outfit mismatch, leftover original clothes,
blended clothing, floating accessories, bad edges, cut-off body
parts
